rejected_rule.statement: An assignment of a decree, being prior in date to the seizure by a judgment-creditor, takes priority over the latter's claim.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "Indeed section 254 seems to say so almost in terms for the seizing creditor is only to be deemed the assignee as of the date of the seizure made by the person against whom he is executing the writ of execution, so far as that person's interest extends. At the date of the seizure the interest of the original plaintiff in this decree had ceased for he had assigned it by assignment No. 309 of September 2, 1931."
